objectives.title: Automated Decision-Making Prohibition
objectives.description: The contract addresses the data subject's right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling.
criteria: Clauses addressing the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects concerning the data subject.
Clauses addressing the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing that similarly significantly affect the data subject.
Confirmation that profiling is included within the scope of the automated decision-making covered.

objectives.title: Automated Decision-Making Exception Grounds
objectives.description: The contract specifies the legal grounds under which decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, may be permitted.
criteria: Terms establishing that automated decisions are permitted when necessary for entering into or performing a contract between the data subject and the controller.

Terms establishing that automated decisions are permitted when authorised by Union or Member State law that lays down suitable safeguards for the data subject's rights, freedoms, and legitimate interests.
Terms establishing that automated decisions are permitted when based on the data subject's explicit consent.

objectives.title: Human Review Mechanisms
objectives.description: The contract defines protocols for human involvement concerning automated outcomes.
criteria: Procedures enabling data subjects to obtain human intervention.
Mechanisms allowing data subjects to express their viewpoint.
Processes permitting data subjects to contest automated decisions.

objectives.title: Sensitive Data Processing Restrictions
objectives.description: The contract regulates automated evaluations involving special categories of personal data.
criteria: Prohibitions against automated decisions under paragraph 2 being based on special categories of personal data referred to in Article 9(1).
Exceptions permitting use of special category data in automated decisions only where the explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a)) or substantial public interest (Article 9(2)(g)) grounds apply.
Measures safeguarding the data subject's rights, freedoms, and legitimate interests when special category data is used in automated decisions.
